title: Monkey wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='face' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c07a3a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#9a5a25'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='46' r='11' fill='#9a5a25'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='46' r='6' fill='#e8b98a'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='11' fill='#9a5a25'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='46' r='6' fill='#e8b98a'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='30' fill='#a86428'/>

  <!-- lighter face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='21' fill='#e8b98a'/>

  <!-- top of head fur tuft -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='24' rx='13' ry='7' fill='#8a4e1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='25' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#a86428'/>

  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='24' y='38' width='24' height='16' rx='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='38' width='24' height='16' rx='5' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='44' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='24' y='38' width='24' height='16' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='52' y='38' width='24' height='16' rx='5' fill='none' stroke='#4a4a8a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <path d='M29 41 L36 41 L31 50 Z' fill='#6a6aa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M57 41 L64 41 L59 50 Z' fill='#6a6aa8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='21' y='43' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#2a2a4a'/>
  <rect x='75' y='43' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#2a2a4a'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f2d0a8'/>

  <!-- nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#8a4e1e'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='60' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#8a4e1e'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 65 Q50 72 58 65' fill='none' stroke='#8a4e1e' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- chin highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#f7dcbb' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
